assertions.assertion: CPT code 93271 is used for cardiac event monitoring
Patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
Patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
Patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Cardiac event monitoring is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
Arrhythmias may be contributing to embolic events
The appeal addresses payer's PR-204 denial
The appeal documents embolic indications for ambulatory cardiac monitoring under the member's benefit plan
